parameters.name: DataSourceId
parameters.description:
The data source ID.

You can call the [ListParserDataSource](~~432676~~) operation to view all data source IDs of the current instance.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: SearchName
parameters.description: A string segment of a topic value. Topics that match this string are returned.
